resume.description: Resume the project build from where it left off — reads PROGRESS.json and launches pending phases in parallel.
resume.prompt: Read PROGRESS.json and BUILD_LOG.md. Determine which phases are pending or failed. Launch the next available phase(s) by delegating to the appropriate subagents in parallel. After each subagent completes, call the logger to update state and the git-manager to commit. Continue until all phases are done or you hit a blocker.

status.description: Show current build progress — what's done, what's pending, what's failed.
status.prompt: Read PROGRESS.json and BUILD_LOG.md. Present a clear summary of the project build state: completed phases, in-progress work, failed phases with reasons, and what's next. Use a simple checklist format.

reset.description: Reset all build progress back to the beginning.
reset.prompt: Tell the logger agent to reset PROGRESS.json — set all phase statuses to 'pending', clear completedPhases and failedPhases, set currentPhase to null, and append a reset entry to BUILD_LOG.md. Then tell git-manager to commit the reset with message 'chore(progress): reset build state'.

commit.description: Manually commit all pending changes to git.
commit.prompt: Run 'git status' to show what's pending. Then call the git-manager subagent to stage all changes and commit with a message describing what changed. Report the commit hash and summary to the user.

push.description: Push committed changes to GitHub remote.
push.prompt: Call the git-manager subagent to push to the remote. If no remote is configured, explain how to set one up (gh repo create or git remote add). If push succeeds, report the result.
